messages:
rachel: Kicking off change-window deploy for v2026.04. Rolling canary 15% global with batching-opt enabled. Watch SLOs (https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve), error budget burn, and any 429/5xx spikes.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by rachel. Canary 15% -> rolling across regions. Flag: batching-opt=true. CI green. Notifying @eng-oncall.

priya: eyeballing the dashboards — traffic looks fine except eu-central shows a 429 surge starting ~30s after rollout. p95 steady but 4xx rising.

matt: logs show upstream rate limiter returning 429s to a subset of pods with new batching header `X-Redwood-Batch: v2`. Possibly upstream configured per-request rate based on header.

ops-sre: concur. 429s are causing client retries and a small 5xx bump at the proxy (retry storm). We should halt ramp and consider pinning routes that talk to that upstream back to v2026.03 or disable batching-opt for eu-central.

rachel: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. We'll add release note line for batching opt and region-level variability.

deploy-bot: Hold confirmed. Canary frozen at 15%.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert: eu-central 429 rate > 0.5% for last 1m. Auto-run diagnostics: `diag deploy v2026.04 --region eu-central --check retries,upstream-429s`.

priya: diagnostic output: upstream-429s tied to header; pods with older proxy config not sending batching header unaffected. Hit pattern: new batch header -> upstream rejects.

matt: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback eu-central to v2026.03 traffic, 2) patch upstream rate-limiter config, 3) disable batching-opt via feature flag for eu-central. Fastest is a regional traffic pin. Ops, can we pin eu-central to previous revision?

ops-sre: yes. Recommend pin route `embeds.eu-central` -> v2026.03 and resume canary elsewhere. Rollback plan if pin doesn't fix: full rollback to v2026.03. Pin command: `route-pin --route embeds.eu-central --version v2026.03 --duration 60m`

rachel: execute pin. @deploy-bot route-pin embeds.eu-central v2026.03 60m. Update release notes: "batching-opt caused 429s in eu-central; regional pin applied; investigating upstream limits."

deploy-bot: Route pin executed. embeds.eu-central -> v2026.03 for 60m. Canary continues in other regions at 15%.

priya: after pin, eu-central 429s drop to baseline within 45s. No sustained 5xx. p95 unchanged. Looks isolated.

matt: I'll open a ticket with the upstream team to coordinate rate limit changes for batching header. Also gathering request traces for the pinned region.

ops-sre: recommend resuming ramp to 30% but keep a 10m hold and alert thresholds tightened for 429s/5xx. If 429s reappear in any region, we pause and either pin that region or disable batching-opt globally.

rachel: @deploy-bot ramp-to 30% over 3m hold 10m. Tighten alerts. Adding note to release draft and changelog: regional pin executed for eu-central due to upstream rate-limit interaction.

deploy-bot: Ramp command accepted. Will abort if 429 > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms.

eng-oncall-bot: Notify: follow-up ticket created (#ENG-INT-214) and assigned to matt and upstream team.

priya: monitoring. so far so good. thanks team — we'll update release notes with the mitigation and recommend customers enable batching with caution in eu-central until upstream adjusts limits.
